why: The real failure is the JSON Schema someone wrote, versioned and never wired to a validator: it ages in silence, diverges from the real data, and the next person reads it as if it were the contract in force. Both trees have the SAME `esquemas/pessoa.schema.json` and both have real code in `src/` — on the fail side that code validates another file. That way the proof blocks both the rule that fails any repository without code and the one that passes any repository with code.
